# METIS Academy

> METIS Academy is an educational platform focused on training professional Software Engineers. It combines deep technical training in Java, C#, mobile and web technologies with language and soft skills development to prepare students for the global IT market. METIS Academy is not just education; it is a pathway to a first paid job in tech, combining deep technical training with immediate career integration so students can earn income while studying.

- [Introductory Video: About METIS Academy, Programmes & How to Apply](https://metis.academy/assets/videos/landing_page_video.mp4): Introductory video explaining METIS Academy, available study programmes, the online education model, student outcomes, and the steps for ordering or applying for a programme.
 
## Key Facts
 
- **Model:** Job-oriented, modular 5 year Software Engineering programme, 100% online via a proprietary educational portal.
- **Primary Language:** English
- **Target Audience:** High school students, university students, career changers, parents, and graduates.
- **Outcome:** Certificates (MAC) and a full diploma (MAD) equivalent to Bachelor's/Master's level education.
- **Financial Freedom:** Students are expected to start working in IT from the 2nd semester.
- **Flexibility:** High intensity in Semester 1 for foundations, standard intensity from Semester 2 for work-study balance.
- **Experience:** 15 years in the market, 1,000+ successful graduates, and a 90%+ employment rate in IT.
- **Format:** Fully online, moderated study with live webinars and real project work.
 
## Core Technologies Taught
 
- **Languages & Frameworks:** Java, C#, Front-End HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Swift for iOS, Kotlin for Android.
- **System Foundations:** Databases, SQL, database administration, operating systems, software testing, QA automation, and DevOps foundations.
